chapter: After Basie: Cafe Society to Los Angeles
title: Streets of Paris and the girl group with Nina Russell and Ginger Smock
summary: She worked six or eight weeks at the Streets of Paris on Hollywood Boulevard, also with Red Norvo. She describes a group of organist Nina Russell, pianist Maida and violinist Ginger Smock, and says Russell now lives in Hungry Horse, Montana.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: That's a very funny thing. Well listen, something else you were talking about. You said when you were with Connie that you played at Streets of Paris.
Were you there quite some time?
We were there about six or eight weeks.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
At Hollywood and the next block from Vine, coming this way. Yeah, I worked there with Red Norvo too. Yeah. Streets of Paris.
I see. And also, you said you worked with Nina Russell?
She is one of the greatest organists.
Yeah, and it was Nina and a girl named Maida. She used to play the piano. And the girl on the violin, that was - the girl that was the greatest violinist I've ever heard, jazz violinist.
Yeah. Oh, honey, you talk about a group - - that was something else.
So all four of you worked together?

S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC.
WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
Really? So she was playing violin. And Nina Russell was playing organ?
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
Oh, Maida. Connie had gone home.
And what was Maida's last name, can you remember?
I can't think of it off hand. I'll think of it after awhile.
I'll bet that was a wonderful girl's group. What a pity that wasn't recorded.
And you all enjoyed working together?
You didn't need a base or a drummer?
What's she doing now, I wonder?

S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC.
WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
She works sometimes. She's the only black in this little town, Hungry Horse, (Montana).
She goes fishing and hunting and everything. That's where she used to love to be. She got a nice camper. Two bedrooms, two baths, living room, dining room, kitchen, camper.
When did you last see her then?
I was up there a couple years ago.
She lost her husband. She used to live down here. She sold the home she had here and moved on up there.
That was courageous of her, wasn't it?
Yeah, because I wouldn't want to go way up there by myself. She just has her dogs.
